name: Mercenary Eye of the Storm
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Eye of the Storm (players/warlock/mercenary/eye_of_the_storm_merc.sval, 25 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 3 (in brackets): storm range 80 (50); use-stormlash false. Its own mana 180, cooldown 12 s. Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon.
summary: The storm strikes enemies within 80 instead of 50 (40 magical, 11 s), but its bolts never trigger Stormlash.
